summary: B2Gold Corp. filed a Form 6-K furnishing Exhibit 99.1, its November 4, 2026 press release reporting third-quarter 2026 operational and financial results. Revenue was $836 million on 195,018 ounces sold at an average realized price of $4,289 per ounce; production totaled 193,321 ounces. AISC of $2,602 per ounce sold accompanied reduced full-year AISC guidance of $2,230–$2,410 per ounce, with production guidance affirmed. A $0.02 quarterly dividend was declared, payable December 15, 2026, to holders of record December 2, 2026. This is a routine earnings disclosure, not a special situation; watch operational delivery, cost trends and Fekola permitting.
